zh: 一条弯曲外线在图像上部形成宽大的覆盖边缘。
上部外线内部有几条短小的深色笔画。
多条长斜笔画向下延伸并在中央收窄。
下部中央有圆钝环状轮廓和交叉痕迹。
一条弯曲的横向带构成图像下边缘。
来源元数据预期有三张图，但当前只有一张本地复核图。
en: A curved outer line forms a broad upper cap across the image.
Several short dark strokes sit inside the upper outlined area.
Long diagonal strokes descend toward a central narrowing.
The lower center contains a rounded loop-like outline and crossing marks.
A curved horizontal band forms the lower edge of the image.
Source metadata expects three images, but only one local review image exists.
These observations describe visible marks only; no component, variant, or reading is assigned.
